meta.title: LUNA Café — A Little Moment of Magic
meta.description: LUNA Café is a neighborhood coffee house for thoughtful coffee, slow mornings, and the little moments in between.

homeIntro.paragraphOne: Somewhere between the first sip and the last page, you find it: a slower kind of morning, a table that quietly turns into an afternoon, and a little corner of the world that feels like yours.
homeIntro.paragraphTwo: We made LUNA for exactly those moments. Come as you are; stay a little longer.

about.intro: LUNA is a neighborhood café built around good coffee, honest food, and the kind of welcome that makes an ordinary day feel a little brighter.
about.storyTitleLineOne: It started with a simple idea.
about.storyParagraphOne: We imagined a café that felt like a friend’s kitchen: good coffee within reach, something lovely in the oven, and always a little more time for one more conversation.
about.storyParagraphTwo: That small idea became LUNA. Today, we still open the doors with the same hope: that you leave feeling a bit more at ease than when you came in.
about.philosophyCopy: We believe the best moments are rarely hurried. So we make things with care, welcome you without fuss, and leave the coffee pot on a little longer.

details.title: The little details
details.copy: A warm hello, your favorite table, a cup made just the way you like it. We notice the small things because they are the big things.

local.title: Good things, close by
local.copy: We work with thoughtful makers and choose seasonal ingredients, bringing a little more care to everything we serve.

welcome.title: Room to be yourself
welcome.copy: Drop in for five minutes or settle in for the afternoon. There is always room at the table, and no reason to rush.
